cc:Work.dc:title: ImageNet-500: Average forgetting
cc:Work.dc:description: ImageNet-500. Average forgetting. Lower is better. Means with ±1 standard error. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.02417v1#S4.T1. Fine-tuning: 50.4 ± 7.2 FID points. Rank-1 EWC only: 41.2 ± 2.3 FID points. Replay: 18.2 ± 4.6 FID points. FTML: 128.5 ± 9.0 FID points. VR-MCL: 96.6 ± 8.4 FID points. Trust Region: 10.6 ± 3.0 FID points.
